About Me

Engineering reliability into every machine I touch

I'm Alif, a fresh Electrical Engineering graduate from UNNES who's been into machines and control systems since my vocational school days.

During two internships at manufacturing companies, I spent a lot of time in the field handling preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting mechanical and electrical faults, panel wiring, and PLC/HMI programming for production automation systems.

I'm also fairly familiar with how maintenance works in an industrial setting — routine machine inspections, logging failure history, and putting together reports for evaluation. I like getting to the root of a problem instead of just patching what's visible on the surface, since that's what really keeps production uptime in check.

Outside of technical work, I've also been active in organizations and served as a chairman, so I'm used to coordinating with different people and managing a team.
